description: This source file implements a server-side component for managing devices, connections, and services in an Android Cuttlefish environment. It includes functions for setting up Unix sockets, HTTP handlers for device and control endpoints, WebSocket proxying for ADB, and gRPC interactions for device management.

methods.name: createUnixSocketEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a Unix domain socket at the specified path, removes existing socket if any, resolves the address, creates the socket, and sets permissions.

methods.name: SetupDeviceEndpoint
methods.description: Sets up a Unix socket for device connections and returns a function to accept and handle device connections.

methods.name: SetupControlEndpoint
methods.description: Sets up a Unix socket for control commands and returns a function to handle control connections.

methods.name: CreateHttpHandlers
methods.description: Creates an HTTP router with various endpoints for device management, service calls, openwrt proxying, and polled connections.

methods.name: controlEndpoint
methods.description: Handles control messages from a control connection, supports pre-register commands.

methods.name: PreRegister
methods.description: Handles pre-registration of devices, manages registration states, and communicates with clients.

methods.name: deviceEndpoint
methods.description: Manages a device connection, handles registration, and forwards messages between device and clients.

methods.name: grpcListServices
methods.description: Invokes gRPC method to list services on a device via proxy.

methods.name: grpcListMethods
methods.description: Invokes gRPC method to list methods of a service on a device.

methods.name: grpcListReqResType
methods.description: Invokes gRPC method to list request/response types for a service method.

methods.name: grpcCallUnaryMethod
methods.description: Calls a unary gRPC method on a device and returns the response.

methods.name: grpcTypeInformation
methods.description: Fetches type information of a service using gRPC.

methods.name: openwrt
methods.description: Proxies HTTP requests to an OpenWrt device via reverse proxy.

methods.name: adbProxy
methods.description: Proxies ADB WebSocket connections to a device's TCP port.

methods.name: listGroups
methods.description: Returns list of device groups.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Returns list of devices, optionally filtered by group.

methods.name: deviceInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed info about a specific device.

methods.name: deviceFiles
methods.description: Serves device files, supports interception for custom responses.

methods.name: createPolledConnection
methods.description: Creates a long-polling connection for device communication.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forwards messages from client to a polled connection's device.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Retrieves messages from a polled connection.
